# Arrive Logistics

Arrive Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Arrive Logistics is a North American logistics brokerage that provides shipping and carrier services. They have a team of partners, team, and technology to deliver fast-growing products. Arrive Logistics employs 2,545 people (+21.0% YoY, +442 people) and has an annual revenue of $810.7M, founded in 2014. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, United States, with presence in Mexico. Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including United States, Mexico, Colombia, Canada, and India).

## About

Arrive Logistics is a top 4 North American truckload brokerage headquartered in Austin, Texas, with 10 locations across North America. Founded in 2014, Arrive delivers unparalleled service and custom strategic solutions to a diverse network of globally recognized brands and vetted carriers. Arrive has 2,000+ employees, 5,500 customers, and 10,000 core carriers in its network. The company has been recognized for its service excellence by more than 50 enterprise shippers in the trailing 36 months. At Arrive, "We Deliver, So You Can.“ For more information, visit www.arrivelogistics.com.
